tasks.instruction: Option A: End on the tactile insert and a silent reaction — finish with S16 (close-up of key in Dinu’s palm) holding, then cut to S17 (Dinu reaction) and fade out on the rain ambience; trim S16 to 4s total screen time and let its sound breathe. Option B: End on an exchange and pullback — keep S15 (handover wide insert) into S14 or S19 for a final two-shot pullback: after S15/ S16, cut to S19 (two-shot, b6) holding for 6s, introduce a slight camera pullback/slow dolly out and bring up a low tension soundbed (distant thunder/low strings) before a hard cut to black.
